info.name: MPDC Notification Service - Complete Scenarios
info.description: Executable notification service scenarios derived from controllers, validators, application policies and template metadata. See postman/README.md. Templates have no versions. Use Fake provider or a controlled test mailbox. Empty optional credentials/fixtures skip dependent requests. Default assertions match Api/appsettings.json. Run folders in order; first request resets run state.

item.name: 01 - Health and setup
item.description: Run the collection in order. Each run creates a fresh namespace. Empty credentials cause dependent requests to be skipped, not passed.

request.description: Development-only seeded account: dev.admin / Dev-Postman-2026! Starts automatically with the Development environment. Captures adminToken for admin requests.

item.name: Same key is isolated in TAN

exec: if(pm.response.code===202) pm.test('Different application gets a different ID',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().notificationId).not.to.eql(pm.variables.get('notificationId')));

request.description: Brevo rejects inline content; SMTP and Fake accept the reference. This fixture checks API validation, not image rendering.

item.name: 10 - Replay (admin and prepared failure fixtures)
item.description: A successful replay requires a pre-existing PermanentlyFailed or DeadLettered notification with valid content. Set failedNotificationId. Invalid replay fixtures require changed application/template settings and replayInvalidNotificationId.

request.description: Prepare a failed notification whose required attachment or template files are unavailable, or whose application is disabled. Do not use an unallowed template (that returns 401).

item.name: 11 - Delivery observation (opt-in)
item.description: Set runDeliveryPolling=true. Run in Collection Runner; polls are bounded. Fake normally ends in Sent. Kafka requires publisher, broker and consumer; Sent means provider acceptance only.

item.name: 12 - Configuration-dependent cases (opt-in)
item.description: Enable runRestrictedConfiguration and configure a restricted application: raw disabled, subject override disabled, MaximumAttachments=0, with restrictedTemplateId allowed and valid. missingTemplateId must be allowed but absent on disk. Disabled credentials refer to a separately disabled application.

request.description: Provide a valid multipart file so model binding succeeds before the application policy check.

item.name: 13 - Large requests and diagnostics (opt-in)
item.description: Large request tests depend on the hosting server enforcing request size limits. Run directly against Kestrel. Diagnostics intentionally generates a server error in Development.
